_about: Vault content ledger: the single source of truth. One entry per published or planned piece, plus stories and tasks on the calendar. Every session reads it (node scripts/library.cjs status) and MUST add/update entries after making or scheduling anything. The user also edits it from the dashboard (drag to reschedule, status, feedback). content/calendar.md is generated from it. Fields: id, type (post|carousel|reel|graphic = feed; story|task = calendar only; brand-asset), pillar (tips|product|problem|community|brand|conversion), topic, angle, hook, keywords[], dot_pose, background (paper|ink|rose|plum|tint), layout, hashtag_set, status (idea|draft|ready|scheduled|posted|retired), post_date (YYYY-MM-DD), post_time (HH:MM Sri Lanka), date_locked (true = user set the date; ask before moving), files[], caption, notes, feedback[{ts,by,text,resolved,reply}], metrics{reach,likes,saves,shares,comments,profile_visits,link_clicks,demo_requests}.
